attempts.note: EU Health Data Lake developer portal named by EUDAMED's own 429 body

summary: EUDAMED has a public web search but no keyless machine interface. A request to the public API path returns HTTP 429 whose JSON body says: 'For automated/machine-to-machine access, please use the official EUDAMED data API instead of scraping the public endpoints.' That official API lives behind the EU Health Data Lake developer portal.
unlock_route: Request an API subscription at the EU Health Data Lake developer portal: https://developer.datalake.sante.service.ec.europa.eu/api-details (EU login + subscription key). Then use the EUDAMED data API instead of the web application.
